text:
maria: Pushing a heads-up — publish pipeline blocked on a regen diff + semver/changelog mismatch for the JS SDK. CI is failing the final publish job.

maria: Error snippet from the job:
```
> npm publish
Error: package.json version (1.2.0) does not match release tag (1.2.0-beta.1)
Publish blocked by: regendiff detected changes in src/types.ts
```

ci-bot: publish-job: failed after 3 retries — see https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/12345

audits-bot: changelog-check: missing entry for 1.2.0 (required for GA publishes)

aj: Did regen run on CI with the same openapi spec? locally I get a one-line type reorder.

sasha: If we force-publish a beta tag we risk breaking sample-apps. Sample app test caught a typing change earlier.

ethan: Quick reproduce steps:
```
# from monorepo root
yarn install
yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-js typegen --verify
# or
yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-js regen --from-openapi
```

maria: I ran `yarn typegen --verify` — it outputs one file changed: `packages/sdk-js/src/generated/types.ts`

aj: Could be a minor ordering difference from ts-printer. I can run prettier + regen to normalize.

ben: We can't bypass the changelog requirement for GA. Options: 1) add an entry + bump semver; 2) publish as `beta` and mark it experimental; 3) revert the typegen change if it's nondeterministic.

sasha: Reverting will be messy for customers. Prefer adding changelog and bumping patch, but confirm whether it's breaking.

maria: The regenerate diff contains a renamed union type key — looks non-breaking but borderline. I'll open a tiny PR with the changelog entry + patch bump and link here.

aj: I'll run full regen with node 20 image to match CI and push any formatting changes.

ci-bot: trigger: scheduled re-run queued (manual approval by ben required)

ben: Holding publish until PR merges and sample-apps pass. @sasha please run the sample-app e2e suite after aj's push.

sasha: Will do — ETA ~45m.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 — includes `CHANGELOG.md` entry and patch bump to 1.2.1

aj: pushed regen fixes + prettier autofix.

sasha: sample-apps green locally, will kick off CI.

ci-bot: SDK publish job: success (staged tag: 1.2.1)

deploy-bot: Release flow: promoted 1.2.1 -> canary

maria: thanks all. Follow-up: open an issue to make typegen output deterministic (ordering + printer config).

ben: +1 — assign to eng-tooling.

maria: closing thread, will track issue #2154.
